director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ke overs se fractions (bhinn) ko number line par dekhenge. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
haan
Riya, maine kya pasand hai poocha tha; “haan” se choice nahi pata chali. Cricket pitch ke aadhe raste par ball ho, number line par kahan dikhaogi?
step by step samjhao
Haan Riya, dheere chalte hain. Number line par zero se one tak ka hissa dekho. Use barabar gaps mein baantte hain. Gaps barabar kyun hon?
chhota bolo
Theek hai Riya, chhota bolungi. Zero se one tak barabar gaps banao; do-paanch ke liye kitne gaps chahiye?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, socho zero se one tak paanch barabar gaps hain. Do-paanch ke liye kitne gaps ginoge?
pata nahi
Riya, do gaps ginoge. Do-paanch mein upar wala do batata hai kitne gaps chalne hain. Zero se ginogi ya one se?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, baat karte hain; fractions baad mein. Kis baare mein baat karni hai?
cricket ke baare mein
Riya, cricket pe baat karenge—bas yeh step pehle. Zero se do gaps gin liye. Do-paanch aadhe se kidhar hai?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: hindi mein batao
Theek hai, ab Hindi mein. Riya, bas khaali jagah bharni hai: do-paanch, aadhe se chhota hai; beech ki jagah se kis taraf aayega?

Theek hai Riya, pehle tum koshish karo. Khaali jagah bharo: 2/5 beech se ___ hai, kyunki 2/5 aadhe se chhota hai.
